tools.name: search_poetry
tools.description: Search public classical Chinese poetry by keyword across authors and works. Returns public URLs and short excerpts. Use get_work or get_author for details.

tools.name: list_dynasties
tools.description: List all public dynasties as name/slug pairs. Use the dynasty name as category when browsing works or authors. Optional browse filters also return live facets for collections, dynasties and types; the static list stays complete.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: List all public collections as name/slug pairs. Use the collection slug as the collection ID string when browsing works. Optional browse filters also return live facets for collections, dynasties and types; the static list stays complete.

tools.name: list_types
tools.description: List all public work kinds as name/slug pairs. Use the kind slug as tag when browsing works. Optional browse filters also return live facets for collections, dynasties and types; the static list stays complete.

tools.name: list_sorts
tools.description: List public work sort labels and slugs. A null slug means omit sort for the site default order.

tools.name: list_themes
tools.description: List the public 主题 taxonomy group with its name, slug and categories.

tools.name: list_festivals
tools.description: List the public 节日 taxonomy group with its name, slug and categories.

tools.name: list_solar_terms
tools.description: List the public 节气 taxonomy group with its name, slug and categories.

tools.name: list_cipai
tools.description: List the public 词牌 taxonomy group with its name, slug and categories.

tools.name: list_seasons
tools.description: List the public 时令 taxonomy group with its name, slug and categories.

tools.name: list_geography
tools.description: List the public 地理 taxonomy group with its name, slug and categories.

tools.name: list_groups
tools.description: List the remaining public taxonomy groups: 选集, 写景, 时间, 花卉, 课本, 城市, 名山, 用典 and 书籍, with their categories.

tools.name: list_works
tools.description: Browse public works with optional collection ID, dynasty name (category), kind slug (tag), sort and page. Returns public work URLs and page metadata.

tools.name: list_authors
tools.description: Browse public authors, optionally filtered by dynasty name (category). Returns public author URLs and page metadata.

tools.name: get_work
tools.description: Read a public work by numeric ID, including poem text, introduction, annotations, translation, collections and quotes. A missing work returns work: null.

tools.name: get_author
tools.description: Read a public author by numeric ID and a page of their works. A missing author returns author: null.
